--8<-- [start:memoization_recipe]
-dynamic(fib_cache/2)

fib(0, 0),
fib(1, 1),
fib(N, F) <- (
    N > 1,
    N1 is N - 1,
    N2 is N - 2,
    fib(N1, F1),
    fib(N2, F2),
    F is F1 + F2,
    assertz(fib_cache(N, F))
)
--8<-- [end:memoization_recipe]

--8<-- [start:counter_recipe]
-dynamic(ctr/1)

ctr(0),

increment(NEW) <- (
    retract(ctr(OLD)),
    NEW is OLD + 1,
    assertz(ctr(NEW))
)

test("counter") <- (
    increment(1),
    increment(2),
    ctr(2)
)
--8<-- [end:counter_recipe]

--8<-- [start:collect_recipe]
-dynamic(result/1)

collect_evens(LIST) <- (
    in_(X, LIST),
    X % 2 == 0,
    assertz(result(X)),
    False
)
collect_evens(_),
--8<-- [end:collect_recipe]
